mapper.select: SELECT id, request_key, actor_type, actor_hash, vid, action, state, event_id, created_at, completed_at FROM video_interaction_request WHERE request_key = #{requestKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_interaction_request( request_key, actor_type, actor_hash, vid, action, state, created_at ) VALUES ( #{requestKey}, #{actorType}, #{actorHash}, #{vid}, #{action}, #{state}, NOW(3) )

INSERT INTO video_interaction_window( actor_type, actor_hash, vid, action, last_counted_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{actorType}, #{actorHash}, #{vid}, #{action}, NULL, NOW(3) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_counted_at = last_counted_at
mapper.update: UPDATE video_interaction_window SET last_counted_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND (last_counted_at IS NULL OR last_counted_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, -#{windowMinutes}, NOW(3)))
UPDATE video_interaction_request SET state = #{state}, event_id = #{eventId}, completed_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM video_interaction_request FORCE INDEX (idx_video_interaction_request_state_completed) WHERE state = #{state} AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, -#{retentionDays}, NOW(3)) ORDER BY completed_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete:
DELETE FROM video_interaction_request
WHERE id IN
#{id}
AND state IN (1, 2) AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, -#{retentionDays}, NOW(3))
WHERE 1 = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM video_interaction_window FORCE INDEX (idx_video_interaction_window_last_counted) WHERE last_counted_at IS NOT NULL AND last_counted_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, -#{retentionDays}, NOW(3)) ORDER BY last_counted_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
